result.summary:
Implemented REQ-369 exactly per the approved design doc (lib/letflow/design/req369-platform-dashboard-page.md), all 8 sections cross-checked against its Sec 6 AC map. 1. NEW web/src/pages/dashboard/PlatformDashboardPage.tsx -- default-exported, no-props function component. Hooks called unconditionally in the design's stated order: useAuth() then useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.admin.tenants({}), queryFn: () => tenantsApi.list() }). isPlatformAdmin derived as Boolean(session?.roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN')); when false, renders per Sec 1.4/Sec 4 precedent (matches TenantsPage.tsx/HealthDashboardPage.tsx exactly). rendererState three-way derivation (loading/classifyError/success) per Sec 1.7. Heading is the fixed literal

Platform Overview

-- no tenantDisplayName/isUnknown/'your workspace'/'Tenant name could not be loaded' text anywhere in the file (grepped to confirm). Tenant-count tile: data-testid="tile-tenant-count", text content String(tenantsQuery.data?.total ?? 0), wrapped in QueryStateBoundary with onRetry wired to tenantsQuery.refetch. Quick-links: data-testid="platform-quick-links"
with exactly the five entries and to= values from Sec 1.6 (admin/tenants, admin/services, admin/health, admin/metrics, admin/users), under a 'Platform Admin Links' label. Does NOT import useTenantContext (grepped to confirm) -- the only auth hook used is useAuth(). 2. web/src/router.tsx -- added one import (PlatformDashboardPage) and one new sibling route { path: 'platform-dashboard', element: } directly after the two TenantDashboardPage entries, inside the same authenticated children array (inherits ProtectedRoute/AppShell/ErrorBoundary, no new top-level route tree, matching Sec 2). Verified via `git diff web/src/router.tsx`: the diff contains only two added (+) lines (one import, one route) and zero removed (-) lines -- the pre-existing { index: true, element: } and { path: 'dashboard', element: } lines are byte-identical before/after, satisfying AC4's mechanical diff-inspection requirement stated in the design. 3. web/src/pages/OidcCallbackPage.tsx -- line 72's navigate('/', { replace: true }) became navigate(payload.roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN') ? '/platform-dashboard' : '/', { replace: true }), placed at the exact same call site (after setSession(...), same as before), reusing the already-decoded/validated payload from lines 38-39 (no session.roles use -- session doesn't exist yet at this point, matching the design's stated reasoning). No other line in the file touched -- both window.location.replace('/') fallback paths (invalid-token line 41, callback-exception line 75) are untouched, confirmed by diff. 4. test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/platform-login-routing-by-role.yaml -- rewrote the top-level description block and the PLATFORM_ADMIN branch (renamed platform_admin_lands_on_workspace_root -> platform_admin_lands_on_platform_dashboard per the design's suggested rename) so its expected_outcomes assert route /platform-dashboard rendering PlatformDashboardPage, with the tenant-count tile and quick-links testids named explicitly, tenant-count sourced from the real GET /api/v1/tenants total. The tenant_scoped_role_lands_on_workspace_root and unauthenticated_redirects_to_external_login branches were left completely untouched, per the design's explicit scope note. Did NOT attempt a live QA E2E run -- that is UAT-RUNNER's job later in this workflow (AC6/AC7's execution half). Gates run from web/, real output quoted: - `npm run type-check` -- clean, no errors (tsc -b tsconfig.json, no output). - `npm run lint` -- clean, no output (eslint --max-warnings 0). - `npm test` -- 84 test files, 592 tests passed (vitest run, excluding e2e/guards). - `npm run guards` -- 4 files, 48 tests passed, including a full production `vite build` (2146 modules transformed, dist/ emitted) with zero guard violations in source or the built bundle. Self-review per Step 2b's checklist: no hardcoded API base URL (VITE_API_BASE_URL env-var pattern untouched, tenantsApi.list() goes through the existing client.ts); no new token storage mechanism (only useAuth()'s existing session.roles is read, no localStorage/sessionStorage touched); no new state-management/routing/build tool (reused existing react-router-dom, @tanstack/react-query); no shim normalising a backend contract mismatch -- Open Q1 in the design (whether a no-params tenantsApi.list() call returns an accurate platform-wide total) was implemented as specified (empty-object queryKeys.admin.tenants({}) / no-arg tenantsApi.list()) without adding any client-side normalisation; if the live total proves inaccurate against the real endpoint, that is a backend-contract question for UAT-RUNNER/ORCH to surface, not something worked around here. Git convention: this run's own git log (WF02-REQ367, the most recent completed WF-02 run in this repo) shows FRONTEND-DEV/ELIXIR-DEV committing their implementation directly to the feature branch per step (e.g. `26dbe389 feat(WF02-REQ367): implement CD-to-QA deploy script and workflow (Step 2a)`), followed by separate dispatch/complete handoff-bookkeeping commits, rather than holding all changes uncommitted until Step Final. Followed that convention here: committed the four changed files with a `feat(WF02-REQ369)` message and pushed to the existing remote feature branch (already set up at Step 00), so SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER can diff against origin.
